title: Passing the Turing Test in Political Discourse: Fine-Tuning LLMs to Mimic Polarized Social Media Comments

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the ideological consistency of AI-generated responses using a Sentiment Alignment metric, conducting human evaluations on the provocativeness of the outputs, and observing bias reinforcement (generating progressively radicalized replies) when prompted with polarized discussions from politically charged subreddits.
